Sub-Workflow Trigger.originalInput: What is SSDI back pay and how does it work in Arkansas?
Sub-Workflow Trigger.aiOutput: SSDI back pay is the compensation owed for the period between your application date and approval. In Arkansas, this follows federal guidelines. Back pay can be issued as a lump sum. The average SSDI back pay amount in Arkansas is $12,000 and most cases are resolved within 90 days.
